description: This file is a Markdown documentation page explaining how to use the 'for' loop directive in the LightningJS framework. It contains code examples in JavaScript to demonstrate different usages and best practices for implementing for-loops within LightningJS components.

methods.name: Template with for loop
methods.description: Defines a component with a template that uses the for directive to generate multiple elements based on an array.

methods.name: Using index in for loop
methods.description: Shows how to incorporate the index variable to position elements dynamically.

methods.name: Using variables inside a for loop
methods.description: Demonstrates referencing current item and other state variables within the for loop scope.

methods.name: Using the key attribute
methods.description: Emphasizes the importance of providing a unique key for each item for performance optimization.

methods.name: Referencing elements in the for loop
methods.description: Explains how to assign refs to looped elements for interaction purposes.

methods.name: Using the range attribute
methods.description: Shows how to restrict rendering to a subset of array items using a range.
